description: This Java source file implements the PermissionDao interface in a Spring-based application. It provides database access methods for Permission entities, including listing permissions, retrieving by ID, filtering by group IDs, and querying by criteria using JPQL and Hibernate.

classes.name: PermissionDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of PermissionDao for database operations related to Permission entities.

methods.name: listPermission
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all Permission entities ordered by ID.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a Permission entity by its ID.

methods.name: getPermissionsListByGroups
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Permission entities associated with specified group IDs.

methods.name: listByCriteria
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of Permissions based on given criteria, including filtering by groups.
